prompt.en: What is kept in the Memorial Chamber of the Peace Tower?
prompt.fr: Que garde-t-on dans la Chapelle du Souvenir de la Tour de la Paix?

explanation.en: The Memorial Chamber holds the Books of Remembrance. Written in them are the names of the men who died serving Canada in war or while on duty.
explanation.fr: La Chapelle du Souvenir abrite les Livres du Souvenir. On y inscrit le nom des hommes morts au service du Canada, à la guerre ou en service.

source.quote: The Memorial Chamber within the Tower contains the Books of Remembrance in which are written the names of soldiers, sailors and airmen who died serving Canada in wars or while on duty.

verification.evidence: The Memorial Chamber within the Tower contains the Books of Remembrance in which are written the names of soldiers, sailors and airmen who died serving Canada in wars or while on duty.
